AppError.description: The app refused the call (`APP_ERROR`, one of its declared errors) or the run trapped (`TRAP`).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed (`BAD_REQUEST`), names a reserved method (`RESERVED_METHOD`), or carries an approval for another call (`WRONG_CHALLENGE`).

ConfirmRequired.description: `CONFIRM_REQUIRED`: approve the call with the passkey and send it again with `confirm`.

Forbidden.description: The caller may not call this method of this app (`FORBIDDEN`), or the app is read-only.

Gone.description: `UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE`: the app is an SDK 0.12 app, which this node no longer runs.

RateLimited.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: a public method's rate, or the node's limits.

Unauthorized.description: No valid session or API key, and the method is not public.

Unavailable.description: `UNAVAILABLE` or `TIMEOUT`: retry with the same idempotency key.

session.description: A passkey session's token or an API key, as `Authorization: Bearer`, inside the sealed channel.

info.description: Generated from the app's ABI (its `calimero:abi` section). Every request and answer travels inside the node's sealed channel, after the client has verified the node's attestation: use mero-js or calimero-client-py as the transport (the typed clients `mero-app-build codegen` writes do), not plain HTTP. `POST /apps/{app}/methods/{name}` runs exactly as `POST /apps/{app}/intents` (a call) or `POST /apps/{app}/views` (a view) with the same `method`: the same authentication, gating, passkey step-up and limits. Errors are `{ error, message, details }`.
info.title: scaffolding-e2e

get.description: Server-sent events: the committed events from log index `from`, then live ones. Each frame's `event` is the event's name, `id` is `<index>:<seq>` and `data` its fields as JSON. A subscriber receives only the events it is in the audience of.
